itemdesc-crystaljar-personal-raw: A crock with a seedling pressed into its clay. Fire it where it stands, in a pit kiln or kiln.
itemdesc-crystaljar-personal-fired: Carried in a bag slot. Its three slots take only crystals, and keep them quiet.
itemdesc-crystaljar-shielded-raw: A crock bound with Awakened sparkstone. Fire it where it stands, in a pit kiln or kiln.
itemdesc-crystaljar-shielded-fired: Carried in a bag slot. Its three slots take only crystals, and hold any of them safely.
blockdesc-crystalrack-*: A stone wine rack with sixteen cells, where crystals lie on their sides. Crystals stored here stay quiet.
